name: PEC Solar Company
old_description: Nestled in the rural and wooded landscapes of Wisconsin, PEC Solar provides custom PV Solar design and installation to residential homes. We’re here to help you lower the energy costs to power your home and help the environment at the same time. Why pay for power from the utility company when you can make it yourself?
about:
PEC Solar Company operates from a location just outside Rio, Wisconsin, in the rural woodlands of the state. The locally owned firm was established by professionals with over 14 years of electrical engineering experience, though a precise founding year is not publicly disclosed. The company focuses on residential solar installations across southern Wisconsin, including the Madison and Milwaukee metropolitan areas.

The company delivers turnkey photovoltaic services: custom system design, permitting, shading analysis using drone-based 3D mapping, installation of roof- or ground-mounted arrays, and ongoing monitoring of panel-level and whole-home energy production. It also installs electric-vehicle charging stations, whole-home battery storage, and natural-gas or propane backup generators, and provides repair service for existing solar arrays.

PEC Solar serves exclusively residential customers in southern Wisconsin. Its projects range from single-family homes to properties with complex shading challenges, and the firm coordinates utility interconnection and incentive paperwork on the homeowner’s behalf.

The company distinguishes itself through its engineering credentials: it holds professional engineering licenses in 11 states, employs the only NABCEP-certified PV Design Specialist in Wisconsin, and maintains REC Certified Solar Professional status alongside a master electrician license and electrical contractor license. It emphasizes a no-pressure sales approach, vetted component selection, and meticulous installation practices.
